investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Veloxa Logistics; Platform: on-premises Kubernetes cluster dc2-prod (kubeadm, 1 control plane + 12 workers); Node range: 10.12.0.0/16 (racks b1-b3); Cluster add-ons: CoreDNS, ingress-nginx, Argo CD; Outbound integrations: payment provider API, AWS SQS (eu-west-1), transactional e-mail relay; Change management: application deployments are GitOps syncs by Argo CD; direct kubectl changes are recorded by the Kubernetes audit log with AUD- identifiers.
